scripts.prebuild: copyfiles -u 0 css/**/* js/**/* imgs/**/* assets/**/* paginas-informacoes/**/*.html admin.html robots.txt sitemap.xml site.webmanifest dist/
scripts.build:css: cleancss -o dist/css/variables.css css/variables.css && cleancss -o dist/css/reset.css css/reset.css && cleancss -o dist/css/layout.css css/layout.css && cleancss -o dist/css/components.css css/components.css
scripts.build:css-extras: cleancss -o dist/css/admin.css css/admin.css && cleancss -o dist/css/trip-details.css css/trip-details.css
scripts.build:js: terser js/main.js -o dist/js/main.js -c -m && terser js/admin.js -o dist/js/admin.js -c -m && terser js/trip-details.js -o dist/js/trip-details.js -c -m
scripts.build: npm run prebuild && npm run build:css && npm run build:css-extras && npm run build:js && npm run build:html
